contradictions.title: Erasure by Design – Legal Summary of Violations
contradictions.claim: Brighton Fringe acted reasonably and legally in managing a safeguarding complaint.
contradictions.reality: Brighton Fringe failed in its statutory safeguarding duty, engaged in public defamation via mass email, withheld evidence in SARs, and replaced the complainant without due governance. These actions constitute legal breaches across five statutes.

reputational: Mass libel, defamatory narrative replacing safeguarding truth
emotional: Institutional abandonment following suicide risk disclosure
financial: Loss of venue access, income, brand reputation
legal: Basis for multiple civil and regulatory claims
